lines.text: Bruh, you forgot your homework again?

data.define: A short reaction to something silly or unbelievable.

example.text: Bruh, you forgot your homework again?

publish.title: What does "bruh" mean?
publish.value: Bruh = I can't believe it. Example: "Bruh, you forgot your homework again?" (very casual English, US).
